rows.body: Upscale full-service flag within the Choice-affiliated portfolio—conversion-friendly kit-of-parts and enterprise distribution, not economy extended-stay or limited-service.
Conversion and repositioning (primary); selective new build where market supports; measured capex with standards clarity.
Gateway and regional-hub conversions, airport-adjacent full-service boxes, and secondary cities where owners want recognizable upscale retail and portfolio loyalty—not a soft independent flag.
